limitations: The checked-in source snapshots are metadata/provenance records, not copies of the full court documents.
This corpus does not contain private FTX customer ledgers, bank statements, exchange database dumps, or customer-level transaction histories.
It therefore validates document-grounded forensic reasoning and provenance, not transaction-level precision/recall.
